android.desc:
Your remote job search, organized

Remote jobs, job alerts and an application tracker in one focused app. AnywhereRoles brings work-from-home roles from multiple sources together, hides closed listings, warns about classic scam red flags, shows the salary when a listing includes one and tells you how many working hours a job shares with your time zone. Swipe through new roles, save strong matches and track each application from applied to offer.

KEY FEATURES
* Remote jobs from multiple sources in one app
* Search by title, skill, company, or keyword
* Swipe through fresh jobs: save with a swipe, pass with another
* Time-zone badge on every job: shared working hours and whether it is open to your country
* Compare up to three companies side by side
* Filters for category, source, date, and employment type
* Saved searches and reusable filter presets
* Job alerts with push notifications
* Save jobs with notes, tags, and folders
* Application tracking from saved to applied, interviewing, and offer, as a list or a kanban board
* Keep the recruiter, hiring manager or referral with each application
* Add a job from any website with its link and track it with the rest
* Salaries on every role that lists one, plus remote job market statistics
* Company directory and company job views
* Offline access to cached jobs and saved roles
* Home screen widget for quick discovery
* Dark mode and Material 3 design

JOB SOURCES
Browse roles from multiple remote job sources. AnywhereRoles shows the source and sends you to the original listing when you are ready to apply.

REMOTE JOBS YOU CAN TRUST
* Dead-link detection: closed jobs are hidden, open ones marked verified
* Scam warnings on listings that show classic red flags
* Hide a job, a company, a keyword or a source you never want to see again
* Labels show if a role is fully remote, limited to certain countries or hybrid, and whether it sponsors visas

STAY AHEAD OF NEW ROLES
* Job alerts for new matching jobs, with quiet hours so nothing buzzes at night
* Alerts show how many new jobs matched since you last looked
* Follow companies and hear when they post new remote roles
* Today feed and a notification inbox for everything that matters

SHORTLIST FASTER
